# create onchain transaction

Create Onchain Transaction

#### Path Parameters

#### Body

Raw unsigned transaction in Hex format (Supports EVM and Solana)

Example:

`"[EVM Example]: 02f00180830f424085057db95cdf825208942225166893d26f2064a15cc84f5b897591a7e6938642a13798e59d80c0808080\n[Solana Example]: "`

#### Response

Unique identifier for the created transaction

Example:

`"0bf7bf1e-bafa-4d7e-9312-fa0bf3b63f27"`
